audit.why: 51.53% WR over 2381 games matches the displayed diffRating band (EVEN).
Lane is correctly framed as a skill-shot poke war decided by Light Binding landing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two applicable interactions from missingInteractions are never stated: Prismatic Barrier (W) absorbing Swain's burst, and Illumination's auto-attack reset being the actual combo tell.
audit.why: Both change concrete play: baiting the shield before committing E, and reading the auto-reset wind-up instead of flinching at the ability cast.
audit.corrected: Folded into dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d, replacing copy-paste bleed with these facts.

edits.before: He out-pokes the general — dodge the keystone, root the gap, and drag the war to drain range.
edits.after: She out-pokes the general — dodge the keystone, root the gap, and drag the war to drain range.

edits.before: E the carrier, pull the fragment, Q the formation — one root taxed three bars and healed yours.
edits.after: Prismatic Barrier (W) absorbs your burst — poke it out before committing the E root, then Q the carrier.

edits.before: Brawling pre-6 at marksman range — the demon era has a start date; respect it.
edits.after: Illumination's reset is the tell, not the cast — step back on the wind-up itself.

edits.before: He out-pokes the general — dodge the keystone, root the gap, and drag the war to drain range.
edits.after: She out-pokes the general — dodge the keystone, root the gap, and drag the war to drain range.

edits.before: Trade at his max range. Brawl inside his zone pre-6. Spend R on poke. And hold the ultimate for the fight it was drafted to decide.
edits.after: Trade at her max range. Brawl inside her zone pre-6. Spend R on poke. And hold the ultimate for the fight it was drafted to decide.

edits.before: - Lux Light Binding: matchup-defining — Everything keys off the root — minion-block it and the combo never starts. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep E Nevermove banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Lux Light Binding: 10s cooldown, matchup-defining — minion-block it and the combo never starts. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep E Nevermove (10s at rank 5) banked for her best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
